Name: Nyapu's Portrait Edit - Sam
Author: imterrifried
Description:
[color=#d9d2e9][size=3][b][center][color=#b6d7a8]Confession: I can't play Stardew without [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491?tab=description]Nyapu's Portraits[/url]﻿﻿ anymore! They're just too cute to live without! And then Sam goes and gets an adorable new beanie?! I couldn't help myself. I had to make this. I just [u]HAD[/u] to.

[/color][color=#f9cb9c]Many thanks to [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/54606682?tab=about+me]Nyapu[/url]﻿﻿ generously allowing us to post edits of their work![/color][color=#b6d7a8] I decided I would share these edits so everyone else can enjoy the new beanie-fied Sam in Nyapu's style, and frankenmeshed some sprites a little so they'd match!  Plus, I also included a version with his hair and outfit recolored in a softer palette, just for funsies. ✍(◔◡◔)[/color][/center][/b][/size][/color]

[center][color=#b45f06]----------[/color][/center]

[size=4][b][color=#ffff00]⚠[/color][color=#00ff00] REQUIRED MODS [/color][color=#ffff00]⚠

[/color][/b][/size][list]
[*][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/url]
[*][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[*][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491?tab=description]Nyapu's Portraits Inspired by Dong[/url] [size=1]([i]technically[/i] optional, but why would you use this portrait mod without the original?)[/size]
[*][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12848]Wedding Reception Portraits for RSV[/url] [size=1](optional, for use with [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]! Only needed for the [i]RECOLORED Sam[/i], since all I did was change the hair color slightly on the wedding portrait.)[/size]﻿
[/list][b][color=#d8d8d8][size=4]

⚙[/size][/color][color=#00ffff][size=4]HOW TO INSTALL[/size][/color][color=#d8d8d8][size=4]⚙
[/size][/color][/b]
[color=#1e84cc]  [b][size=2]FOR ORIGINAL PALETTE SAM:[/size][/b][/color]
[list=1]
[*][size=3]Make sure you have the required mods listed above downloaded and up-to-date.[/size]
[*][size=3]Download the file on this mod listed as[b] " Nyapu's Portrait Edit - Sam's Beanie "[/b][/size]

[*][size=3]Extract the contents of the .zip file and either [i]move [b]or[/b] copy/paste[/i] the folder inside of it titled[b] " [CP] Nyapu's Portrait Edit - Sam's Beanie " [/b]into your Mods folder. [/size]
[*][size=3]Load up your game and have fun!!! *[/size]

[/list]
[b]   [size=2][color=#1e84cc]FOR SOFTER PALETTE SAM:[/color]
[/size][/b][list=1]
[*][size=3]Make sure you have the required mods listed above downloaded and up-to-date.[/size]
[*][size=3]Download the file on this mod listed as [b]" Nyapu's Portrait Edit - Sam's New Look "[/b][/size]
[*][size=3]Extract the contents of the .zip file and either [i]move [b]or [/b]copy/paste[/i] the folder inside of the extracted folder titled [b]" [CP] Nyapu's Portrait Edit - Sam's New Look "[/b] into your Mods folder.[/size]
[*][size=1](Optional)[/size][size=3] If you use Nyapu's replacement portraits for [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12848]the vanilla bachelors/bachelorettes in Ridgeside's Wedding Reception
[/url],  open a separate window and find the folder titled [b]" [CP] Wedding Reception Portraits for RSV "[/b] in your Mods folder, open it [i]AND[/i] the [b]" Assets "[/b] subfolder inside, and then simply [i]move [b]or [/b]copy/paste[/i] [/size][size=3]the image inside of the [b]" Nyapu's Portrait Edit - Sam's New Look "[/b] folder simply titled [b]" Sam "[/b] of him holding his guitar while wearing a suit into the [b]" Assets "[/b] folder. When prompted, replace the image in the folder.[/size]
[*][size=3]Load up your game and have fun!!! *[/size]
[/list]
[color=#d0e0e3][size=2]* Note: This is my first time ever messing with coding! I tested the mod in my own game first and everything looked alright for me, but please let me know in the comments if you experience any glitches/errors and I will do my best to figure out how to fix them. Happy gaming! 🎉*[/size][/color][size=3][color=#d0e0e3]
[/color]

[/size][center][color=#b45f06]----------﻿[/color][/center]
